statement.value: WorkerManagementSystem() starts empty. addWorker(workerId, position, compensation) adds a worker and returns true, or returns false and changes nothing when the id exists. registerWorker(workerId, timestamp) returns "invalid_request" for an unknown worker; otherwise it records an entry when the worker is outside the office and an exit when inside, and returns "registered". registerWorker timestamps strictly increase. get(workerId) returns the total length (exit - entry) of the worker's finished sessions, or -1 for an unknown worker; an open session does not count. topNWorkers(n, position) ranks the workers whose current position equals position by their finished time in that position, longest first and then by workerId ascending (code-point order), and returns the first n as "id(time)" items joined by ", " (an empty string when none). promote(workerId, newPosition, newCompensation, startTimestamp) returns "invalid_request" for an unknown worker or one that already has a pending promotion; otherwise it stores the promotion and returns "success". A pending promotion takes effect at the worker's first entry with timestamp >= startTimestamp: position and compensation change before that session starts. topNWorkers then counts only sessions started since the promotion took effect. calcSalary(workerId, startTimestamp, endTimestamp) returns, for an unknown worker -1, otherwise the sum over finished sessions [entry, exit) of the length of their overlap with [startTimestamp, endTimestamp) times the compensation in force when the session started. setDoublePaid(startTimestamp, endTimestamp) marks [startTimestamp, endTimestamp) as double-pay time (overlapping periods do not stack). In calcSalary every overlapped time unit that is also double-pay time is paid twice.

value: WorkerManagementSystem() starts empty.
addWorker(workerId, position, compensation) adds a worker and returns true, or returns false and changes nothing when the id exists.

registerWorker(workerId, timestamp) returns "invalid_request" for an unknown worker; otherwise it records an entry when the worker is outside the office and an exit when inside, and returns "registered".
registerWorker timestamps strictly increase.
get(workerId) returns the total length (exit - entry) of the worker's finished sessions, or -1 for an unknown worker; an open session does not count.

topNWorkers(n, position) ranks the workers whose current position equals position by their finished time in that position, longest first and then by workerId ascending (code-point order), and returns the first n as "id(time)" items joined by ", " (an empty string when none).

promote(workerId, newPosition, newCompensation, startTimestamp) returns "invalid_request" for an unknown worker or one that already has a pending promotion; otherwise it stores the promotion and returns "success".
A pending promotion takes effect at the worker's first entry with timestamp >= startTimestamp: position and compensation change before that session starts.
topNWorkers then counts only sessions started since the promotion took effect.

calcSalary(workerId, startTimestamp, endTimestamp) returns, for an unknown worker -1, otherwise the sum over finished sessions [entry, exit) of the length of their overlap with [startTimestamp, endTimestamp) times the compensation in force when the session started.
setDoublePaid(startTimestamp, endTimestamp) marks [startTimestamp, endTimestamp) as double-pay time (overlapping periods do not stack).
In calcSalary every overlapped time unit that is also double-pay time is paid twice.
up to 1e5 calls
workerId and position match [A-Za-z ]{1,20}
1 <= compensation <= 1e6
0 <= timestamps <= 1e9, registerWorker timestamps strictly increasing
sum over topNWorkers calls of the number of workers <= 2e6
sum over calcSalary calls of the worker's register calls <= 2e6
startTimestamp <= endTimestamp
at most 1000 setDoublePaid calls, start < end
